author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Stop typing and start talking! Learn how to use ChatGPT Voice in this step-by-step tutorial for beginners. Discover how to have natural, back-and-forth conversations, brainstorm ideas, and use voice mode for more than just asking questions. You'll also learn how to change ChatGPT’s voice and preferred spoken language. 

In this video, you’ll learn how to:
• Start a ChatGPT Voice conversation and understand Voice vs. Dictation
• Interrupt responses, ask follow-up questions, and adjust speaking speed
• Brainstorm ideas for videos, presentations, projects, and travel
• Practice job interviews, presentations, and more
• Learn a language through conversations and role-playing
• Upload files and discuss them with ChatGPT
• Enable background conversations for hands-free use
• Change ChatGPT’s voice and preferred spoken language

title: How to Use ChatGPT Voice - Step-by-Step for Beginners
